parent_answers.who_he_is: Open-minded across cultures, kind, with a strong sense of justice and fairness. What lights him up is interesting problems and debates — he loves to take apart something happening in politics or business ('what if we did this vs that'), comparing outcomes, repercussions, and strategies. A strong business mind and a strong sense of social justice; also loves language. Highly sensitive — sensitive to others' emotions, and affected by rudeness or aggression; thrives in a supportive environment. Very socially adept, makes friends easily, people seek him out.
parent_answers.business_spine: Runs a real Pokemon-card business that makes a few thousand dollars a year — a real little business with customers. Earlier ran an in-game Roblox business selling to other kids. The current goal: find cards that can be saved and become valuable to help pay a semester of college tuition ($5,000-$10,000). These are the ideas that light him up.
parent_answers.how_he_learns: Thrives when instructions are clear, there's structure, milestones, and a chance to make up mistakes (a retake, extra credit). Struggles with one-big-test, sink-or-swim formats where a single test drops an A to a B. Needs the teacher to actually teach the concept first, then practice. Needs a lot of encouragement.
parent_answers.social_style: Strongly prefers teams and groups; learns by listening and discussion; mostly social but needs downtime.
parent_answers.intended_direction: Business/Finance, Law/Government, Writing/Communications, Liberal arts/Humanities, Social sciences. Parent's words: 'a good business school or law school or school of public affairs or politics.' Prefers strong, well-known schools.
